parts.title: Overview
parts.body:
You can get £116.75 per week Statutory Sick Pay (SSP) if you're too ill to work. It's paid by your employer for up to 28 weeks.

Eligibility

You must be an employee and have been ill for at least 4 days in a row (including non-working days).

parts.title: What you'll get
parts.body:
SSP is £116.75 a week. Your employer pays it in the same way as your normal wages.

Tax and National Insurance

SSP is subject to tax and National Insurance in the usual way.
